config.script:
def sanitizeTree(element):
		"""
		A custom deep copy functon for dicts/lists that converts
			the Perspective property object wrappers to the
			Python equivalent.
			
		Args:
			element: The Perspective property object wrapper.
		
		Returns:
			A deep copy (Python equivalent) of the Perspective
			property object wrapper passed in (element).
		"""
		if hasattr(element, '__iter__'):
			if hasattr(element, 'keys'):
				return dict((k, sanitizeTree(element[k])) for k in element.keys())
			else:
				return list(sanitizeTree(x) for x in element)
		return element
		
	def containsAssociatedData(alarm):
		"""
		Checks to see if the alarm has any associated data properties, and if it
			does, creates list of the names of the associated data properties.
			
		Args:
			alarm: The alarm object being searched.
			
		Returns:
			A tuple in which the first element is False if the alarm does not
			have any associated data properties, or True if the alarm does
			have associated data prperties, and in which the second element
			is a list that is empty if the alarm does not have associated data 
			properties, or it contains the name of the associated data
			propertie(s) (if the alarm has at least one).
		"""
		builtInProperties = {'name','enabled','priority','timestampSource',
								'label','displayPath','ackMode','notes','ackNotesReqd',
								'shelvingAllowed','mode','setpointA','inclusiveA','anyChange',
								'setpointB','inclusiveB','bitPosition','bitOnZero','isActive',
								'deadband','deadbandMode','timeOnDelaySeconds','timeOffDelaySeconds',
								'ackPipeline','activePipeline','clearPipeline','voip_customMessage',
								'CustomEmailMessage','CustomEmailSubject','CustomSmsMessage','activeCondition'}
		if set(alarm.keys()).issubset(builtInProperties) == True:
			return (False,[])
		else:
			# return a list of associated data props
			return (True,[prop for prop in alarm.keys() if prop not in builtInProperties])
	
	# after making changes to alarms for the tag, time to commit the changes
	config = sanitizeTree(self.view.params.tagConfig)
	if len(config.keys()) == 0:
		system.perspective.openPopup("commit-warning",'Exchange/Alarm Configurator/Framework/Popup', params = {'title':'Error','body':'No tag selected.','id':'commit-warning'},showCloseIcon=False,draggable=False,viewportBound=True,overlayDismiss=True,modal=True)
	else:
		# when editing the mode of an alarm, the 'display name' of the property is saved in the
		# local tagConfig rather than the 'underlying name'; so, if the mode of any alarms was
		# edited, change the 'display name' to 'underlying name' before sending changes to 
		# system.tag.configure
		alarmModeMap = {None:'Equality','Not Equal':'Inequality','Equal':'Equality', 'Below Setpoint':'BelowValue','Above Setpoint':'AboveValue', 'Between Setpoints':'BetweenValues', 'Outside Setpoints':'OutsideValues','Out of range':'OutOfEngRange','Bad Quality':'BadQuality','Any Change':'AnyChange','Bit State':'Bit','On Condition':'OnCondition'}
		
		# get the parent path of the tag
		tagPath = config['path']
		pathParts = tagPath.split(']')
		provider = pathParts[0] + ']'
		pathParts = pathParts[1].split('/')
		parentPath = provider
		for i in range(0,len(pathParts)-1):
			parentPath = parentPath + pathParts[i] + '/'
		
		if '/' in parentPath:
			parentPath = parentPath[:-1]

		# get the full current config of the tag and clear out the alarms list
		currConfig = system.tag.getConfiguration(tagPath)[0]
		currConfig['alarms'] = []
		
		canSave = True
				
		# correcting the mode and changing voip_customMessage back to 
		# voip.customMessage if any of the alarms have this property
		for alarm in config['alarms']:
			if 'mode' in alarm.keys():
				oldMode = str(alarm['mode'])
				alarm['mode'] = alarmModeMap[oldMode]
			if 'voip_customMessage' in alarm.keys():				
				alarm['voip.customMessage'] = alarm['voip_customMessage']
				del alarm['voip_customMessage']
			
			associatedData = containsAssociatedData(alarm)
			if associatedData[0]:
				for associatedDataProp in associatedData[1]:
					if alarm[associatedDataProp] == None:
						canSave = False
						break
			
			currConfig['alarms'].append(alarm)
		
		if canSave:				
			logger = system.util.getLogger('configurator.lg.commit')
			logger.debug('commit pressed; new config= ' + str(currConfig) + '; parentpath= ' + str(parentPath))
			
			# call system.tag.configure with parent path to commit the changes
			results = system.tag.configure(parentPath,currConfig,'o')
			
			# get the result of the configure, display a popup containing the results, and refresh the tagConfig
			
			body = 'Tag edit successful!'
			
			if str(results[0]) == 'Good':
				body = 'Tag edit successful!'
				system.perspective.openPopup("commit",'Exchange/Alarm Configurator/Framework/Popup', params = {'body':body,'id':'commit'},showCloseIcon=False,draggable=False,viewportBound=True,overlayDismiss=True,modal=True)
				system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshTagConfig", payload = {}, scope = "page")
			else:
				body = 'Tag edit failed'
				system.perspective.openPopup("commit",'Exchange/Alarm Configurator/Framework/Edit Failed Popup', params = {'body':body,'id':'commit','error':results.toString()},showCloseIcon=False,draggable=False,viewportBound=True,overlayDismiss=True,modal=True)
		else:
			body = 'Unsupported data type detected. Please make these changes in the Designer.'
			system.perspective.openPopup("commit",'Exchange/Alarm Configurator/Framework/Popup', params = {'body':body,'id':'commit'},showCloseIcon=False,draggable=False,viewportBound=True,overlayDismiss=True,modal=True)

# reverting any alarm changes that the user made; setting selectedRow of alarm list to none,
	# refresh the tagConfig (via send message to refreshTagConfig), hide the alarm list if it is
	# being displayed, hide the property editor if it is being displayed, display the tag tree, 
	# and update the params that are passed to the binding editor (via send message to 
	# updateBindingEditor)
	
	logger = system.util.getLogger('configurator.sm.revert')
	logger.debug('revert button pressed; setting selectedRow=None for alarm list and refreshing binding on tagConfig')
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("updateSelectedRow", payload = {'row':None}, scope = "page")
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Alarms").getChild("Alarm Container").getChild("Alarm List").props.selection.selectedRow = None
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshTagConfig", payload = {}, scope = "page")
	
	if self.parent.parent.getChild("Alarm List Header").position.display == True:
		self.parent.position.display = False
		
		# hide alarm list
		componentsToHide = ["Alarm List Header","Alarms","Edit Alarm"]
		for comp in componentsToHide:
			self.parent.parent.getChild(comp).position.display = False
		
	elif self.parent.parent.getChild("Property Editor Header").position.display == True:
		# hide property editor
		componentsToHide = ["Property Editor Header","Properties Cont"]
		for comp in componentsToHide:
			self.parent.parent.getChild(comp).position.display = False
	
	# show tag tree
	componentsToShow = ["Header","Tag Tree","Edit Tag"]
	for comp in componentsToShow:
		self.parent.parent.getChild(comp).position.display = True
	
	payload = {'name':'','prop':{},'displayName':''}
			
	system.perspective.sendMessage("updateBindingEditor", payload = payload, scope = "page")
